## Summary

Describe the non-sensitive documentation, standalone lab or approved validation/evidence-integrity toolkit change. Reference a starter task where relevant. State what you inspected, which component tests you ran, the observed outcomes and limitations.

## Checks

- [ ] Public-safe content only; no credentials, personal information or private source.
- [ ] Links and claims checked; no fictional results presented as observed.
- [ ] No security settings, operational authority or access changes.
- [ ] I have the right to share this material.

Do not submit vulnerabilities or sensitive evidence here. Owner review is required before merging.

## Contribution security

Read the [external contribution security policy](../docs/EXTERNAL_CONTRIBUTION_SECURITY.md).

- [ ] All dependency, build, test and automation changes are disclosed and justified.
- [ ] No unexplained executable content, new network access or credential requests.
- [ ] Test scope and limitations are reported; no private systems or credentials were used.

Maintainer review must cover the exact proposed revision; changes after review require renewed review. Public acceptance does not authorise private integration or execution.
